thesis: Sylvan Library turns every draw step into a three-card selection puzzle and lets life become additional cards when the game demands raw velocity.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards. If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn. For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.
canonicalIdentity.identityNotes: Original Legends 1994-06-01 credited to Harold McNeill; printing ID remains from accepted snapshot. Modern Oracle text is not misidentified as original printed wording. Verified focused mechanics source: https://mtg.wtf/card/leg/207/Sylvan-Library
